interpretiveRules: UNKNOWN is not a positive acceleration fact.
PARTIAL evidence is tested against the literal registered trigger; it does not self-activate acceleration.
A public applicant-proposal document inventory is contextual evidence only unless a site fact is independently transferable to the Reference House candidate.
No-match or no-report in a bounded public source is not proof that a constraint is absent.
Future-due evidence remains future-due unless an actual registered acceleration condition is positively established.
